opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society, or undertaking research on proposals already approved where volumes are under contract to the Society. Recipients of support need not be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: The Hakluyt Society supports research undertaken in preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society (category A), or research towards completion of publication projects approved by the Society and under contract (category B). Payments are made as reimbursements of previously agreed expenditure, sourced from the Society's Harry & Grace Smith Fund, and may relate to volumes for the main series (Series III) or the Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel.
